title: Average house price (UK HPI)
verdict: £272,642 in Sep 2026, 1.2% up on a year earlier.
note: UK HPI file 2026-09. Mix-adjusted average price from completed sales registered with HM Land Registry, Registers of Scotland and Land & Property Services NI; recent months are revised as more sales are registered.
